verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists a category for installing, creating and publishing Kimi plugins and skills. Kimi Claw documents connecting to Feishu. Together these suggest an installable plugin ecosystem with at least one third-party connector, but the evidence is only help-center headings. Missing for 10: evidence of a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps/connectors, documented steps for adding connectors to the assistant, breadth of available third-party integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
